sections.text:
Stitches as with pins in the palm of the left hand, between the
first and second fingers ; these disappear after scratching, but afterwards
return with burning,'. — Dull painful stitches in the skin of the lower por-

right hand,'. — Itching of the skin in front of and above the left ear, dis-
appearing as soon as he touches it,'.
